camel_example: aliyun gwlb ListListeners --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tagKey --NextToken d209f4e63ec942c967c50c888a130000 --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value tagValue --LoadBalancerIds.1 'gwlb-rbtjolkkbudmrr0000' --Skip 10 --ListenerIds.1 'lsn-w3t3vpgjj12b2i0000' --method POST --force
description_en: Queries listeners for Gateway Load Balancers
description_zh: 查询负载均衡监听列表
kebab_example: aliyun gwlb list-listeners --listener-ids lsn-w3t3vpgjj12b2i0000 --load-balancer-ids gwlb-rbtjolkkbudmrr0000 --next-token d209f4e63ec942c967c50c888a130000 --max-results 20 --tag Value=tagValue Key=tagKey --skip 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListListeners

parameters.help_en: The listener IDs. You can specify up to 20 listener IDs
parameters.help_zh: 监听ID列表，最多支持20个监听ID
parameters.name: listener_ids

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instances. You can specify up to 20 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例ID。最多支持20个实例ID
parameters.name: load_balancer_ids

parameters.help_en:
The token that is used for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query is performed.

If a value is returned for NextToken, the value is the token that is used for the next query
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

fields.help_en:
The tag key. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。

一个标签健最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The tag value. The tag value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags in each call
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。一次调用最多支持 20 个标签
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to skip for a paged query
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，跳过的条目数
parameters.name: skip

Listeners.description_en: A list of listeners for the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
Listeners.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡监听列表

ListenerStatus.description_en:
The status of the listener. Valid values:

Provisioning: The listener is being created.

Running: The listener is running.

Configuring: The listener is being configured.

Deleting: The listener is being deleted
ListenerStatus.description_zh:
当前监听的状态，取值：

Provisioning：创建中。
Running：运行中。
Configuring：配置中。
Deleting：删除中

LoadBalancerId.description_en: The ID of the Gateway Load Balancer (GWLB) instance
LoadBalancerId.description_zh: 网关型负载均衡实例的ID

TcpIdleTimeout.description_en: The timeout period of an idle TCP connection

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned on each page. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 使用NextToken方式查询时，每次最多返回的结果数。取值范围：1~1000。默认值：20
